title: 洛杉矶市长选战聚焦居住成本
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The California dream isn't as easy as it used to be, and the L.A. mayor's race can help define who can still achieve it.
segments.zh: 加州梦不再像过去那样容易实现，而洛杉矶市长竞选有助于界定谁仍能实现它。

segments.en: The California dream has existed for generations. People moved to California for lots of reasons.
segments.zh: 加州梦已存在几代人。人们搬到加州有诸多原因。

segments.en: The climate, the mountains, the beaches. In L.A. specifically, it is often meant buying a house, or the yard, and having a pool. It was during World War II that Los Angeles really experienced a
segments.zh: 气候、山脉、海滩。具体到洛杉矶，这通常意味着买房、带院子、有泳池。正是在二战期间，洛杉矶真正经历了

segments.en: population boom. The city became a manufacturing hub and lots of people moved here for the jobs.
segments.zh: 人口激增。这座城市成为制造业中心，许多人搬到这里找工作。

segments.en: Then decades later, California stopped building housing enough to keep up the population.
segments.zh: 几十年后，加州停止建造足够住房以跟上人口增长。

segments.en: Demand out grew supply. Now many of the homes that people bought from modest prices decades ago are worth much, much more. The median home price in Los Angeles is now about a million dollars.
segments.zh: 需求增长超过供应。如今许多几十年前以适中价格购买的房屋价值已高得多。洛杉矶的住宅成交中位价现在约为一百万美元。

segments.en: The mayoral race is offering two competing visions for Los Angeles. We have incumbent Karen Bass, who's running against current city council member Nithia Raman. Karen Bass is running a campaign
segments.zh: 市长竞选为洛杉矶提供了两种竞争愿景。我们有现任市长凯伦·巴斯，她正与现任市议员尼提亚·拉曼竞争。凯伦·巴斯正在开展一场

segments.en: really focused on proving the quality of life in Los Angeles. However, she's pretty unpopular. Part of the reason is because of her handling of the fires and the Pacific palisades last year. Another reason
segments.zh: 真正专注于证明洛杉矶生活质量的竞选。然而，她相当不受欢迎。部分原因是她去年对火灾和太平洋帕利塞兹的处理。另一个原因

segments.en: is because homelessness has not dropped in the way that a lot of people had expected. Her challenger, Nithia Raman, is a member of the city council. She's also a democratic socialist. She's
segments.zh: 是无家可归者人数没有像许多人预期的那样下降。她的挑战者尼提亚·拉曼是市议会成员。她也是一名民主社会主义者。她

segments.en: really running a campaign focused on making the city run better and make a better use of its physical resources. She also wants to build quite a bit of housing and build it everywhere and build
segments.zh: 真正开展一场专注于让城市运行得更好、更有效利用其物理资源的竞选。她还希望建造相当多的住房，并在各处建造，并建造

segments.en: it densely, and that's aimed at a lot of the runners who are struggling to make ends meet in a city that's extremely unaffordable. In many ways, the L.A. mayoral race is really just a microcosm of the larger
segments.zh: 密集地针对许多在极度难以负担的城市中挣扎着维持生计的工薪族。洛杉矶市长竞选在许多方面只是更大斗争的缩影。
